commit.message:
wp433 P2a: credentials.json cua gws (W4, W5) tren POSIX nam ngoai kho git, khong xuyen lien ket, ghi nguyen tu

Dac ta GWS-CRED-DICH-NGOAI-KHO-A r1 (sha256 b0065947f941...), lease wp433-r2-g1-claude, Issue #433.

- M1 `_duong_dich_chuan(p, cwd)`: ghep cwd theo chuoi, bo thanh phan rong va `.`, tu choi NUL / chi khoang
  trang / `..` / goc `/`; ly do `duong khong hop le: <repr>`.
- M2 `_dich_cred_gws(cfgdir_tho)`: POSIX goi `_kiem_dich_ghi(dest, "/", <moi thanh phan>)` nen luat (b) lstat
  moi to tien tu `/` toi chinh tep; nen khac giu dich nhu cu. W4/W5 ghi bang `_ghi_nguyen_tu_0600`, chot dich
  va writer trong mot `try ... except OSError`. W4 kiem kieu/encode truoc; `gws_cred` co mat ma sai kieu
  (ke ca falsy) bi tu choi thay vi coi la thieu.
- M3: W4 in dung mot dong `[bootstrap] ✗ <cum>: <chi tiet>` + degraded; W5 tra `(False, "<cum>: ...")`.
- M4: fragment wp433_gws_cred_dich_ngoai_kho — 11 ca / 46 luot, 37 dot bien, 3 tu kiem phan hang, so luot.
- M5: tai sinh scripts/tl_test_fragments_bundled.py bang generate_bundled_module_bytes.

Khong sua than `_kiem_dich_ghi`, `_trong_kho_git`, `_ghi_nguyen_tu_0600`. Windows: chi doi sang ghi nguyen tu.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
